electrical.notes: SN74LS642-1 figures (page 7): IOL 48 mA (the plain SN74LS642 is 24 mA); off-state output current 0.1 mA max at 5.5 V. Hysteresis at A and B inputs 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ; thresholds not given.

notes: The datasheet gives one switching column for 'LS642 and 'LS642-1 together (page 8, printed sideways). A and B pins are both inputs and outputs; listed with role output (open-collector) as the 8553 file does. Exact-name file: the drawing's 74LS642_1 is the datasheet's SN74LS642-1.
